title: Bloukrans Bridge
visualBrief: 451m N2 concrete deck arch bridge with272m single broad arch, approximately62m arch rise, paired open vertical spandrel columns, approach piers and abutments, two-lane charcoal roadway, pale slotted concrete parapets, narrow under-deck catwalk and central bungee platform. River gorge and detached visitor buildings are excluded;216m river clearance is a site fact, not an invented line of tall piers.

appearance.colorEncoding: sRGB palette decoded to linear COLOR_0

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Native mapped N2 bridge centerline fixes centroid and heading; dry eastern N2 approach240m from center defines deck-level datum. Source terrain remains unchanged. Flat inspection stage is below the arch so the open span is visible; host ravine and springing contact remain approximate.

terrainReference.basis: Dry eastern N2 approach beyond mapped bridge end, chosen before terrain acquisition. Deck surfaceY0 matches this approximate road datum.

geographicProposal.notes: Native line is about463m including road end transitions;451m reported bridge centered within it without changing source coordinates. Bank/springing contact is approximate; landscape and river are not bridge geometry.

limitations: Primary ACI1981 construction abstract and Qualla agree on451m total length,272m arch span and216m river clearance. Native mapped bridge centerline includes about12m of end transition beyond the reported bridge length; it controls centroid/heading, not a rescaling of the whole structure.

Two inspected public-domain NJR ZA Qualla originals control the single broad concrete arch, repeated paired columns, slab/parapets and under-deck bungee platform. Rise,16m width, precise bay count, section thickness, hidden faces, platform/catwalk dimensions and bank-pier foundations are photographic medium-fi estimates. No engineering drawing or non-public-domain imagery used.
Static exterior only: no traffic, people, operator logos, active bungee ropes or detached visitor facilities. No navigable internal structural box or engineering-grade collision.

Bank reference and source terrain are approximate. Actual216m gorge/forest/river are supplied by the host landscape, not authored into the bridge. Gorge/rock contact is not surveyed and no source elevation is fitted to the model. Original photos remain in Qualla and are not textures.
